materialNews.reportedBy: Adam Schefter (ESPN), relayed by CBS Sports and RotoWire
materialNews.detail: Cardinals reportedly told Harrison he will be inactive Sunday, October 11, while the club finalizes a trade. Sunday official 90-minute inactive list has not yet been issued; trade is not yet official.
materialNews.impact: Remove small (~8.8% / 13 of ~148) Harrison season target share in conditional model, with potential marginal extra work for Trey McBride, Michael Wilson, Kendrick Bourne. Do not treat it as automatic large target vacuum: McBride ~46 targets (31.1%), Wilson ~44 (29.7%) through 4 games. A top-line production jump beyond market adjustment cannot be assumed.
